proposals.summary: Crow proposes “investing in workforce development, apprenticeship training” and growing industries such as health care, technology, and renewable energy.

evidence.excerpt: By investing in workforce development, apprenticeship training, and growing industries like healthcare, technology, and renewable energy, we can open the door to career advancement and better opportunities for Colorado families.
evidence.locator: Better Jobs & More Economic Opportunity, sentence beginning By investing

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Better Jobs & More Economic Opportunity; House Issues index: An Economy for the Working Class. Undated statements retrieved October 25, 2026; chronology and continued applicability to the 2026 election require human confirmation. Limited source review, not exhaustive; no funding level or timetable is supplied in the quoted passage.

proposals.summary: Crow calls for government resources and private-sector partnerships to “create new affordable housing” for both sale and rent.

evidence.excerpt: We need to leverage government resources in partnership with private sector activity to create new affordable housing based on a multi-pronged approach that supports both for sale and rental housing.

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Housing Affordability; House Issues index: Lower Costs for Coloradans. Both undated, retrieved October 25, 2026; no chronology established. Limited source review, not exhaustive. The quoted passage does not identify a funding amount, subsidy design, or construction target. Human confirmation of current applicability is pending.

proposals.summary: Crow says, “I will fight for a public option,” with the stated aims of reducing costs and increasing consumer choice.

evidence.excerpt: I will fight for a public option that will reduce costs and increase choices for  consumers.
evidence.locator: Health Care, sentence beginning I will fight for a public option; original double space retained

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Health Care; House Issues index: Lower Costs for Coloradans. Both undated, retrieved October 25, 2026; chronology and current 2026 applicability unconfirmed. The summary attributes intended benefits rather than predicting effectiveness. The campaign section also discusses preserving existing coverage; no specific public-option implementation is supplied in the quoted sentence. Not comprehensive health-policy coverage, including reproductive health.

proposals.summary: Crow calls for ensuring that “student loans are affordable,” higher-education costs are reasonable, and “community colleges and technical training opportunities are available and reliable.”

evidence.excerpt: We must ensure that student loans are affordable, costs of higher education are reasonable, and that community colleges and technical training opportunities are available and reliable so that job training and re-training for tomorrow’s economy is available to all Americans.
evidence.locator: Education, sentence beginning We must ensure

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Education, with surrounding context inspected. Undated page retrieved October 25, 2026; no claim this is the latest statement. General goals only: no loan rate, cost cap, or implementation mechanism inferred. Human confirmation of 2026 applicability pending. Limited source review, not exhaustive.

proposals.summary: Crow calls for the U.S. to “re-engage with other nations to work towards climate solutions,” including “encouraging clean energy transitions.”

evidence.excerpt: We must re-engage with other nations to work towards climate solutions, including encouraging clean energy transitions.
evidence.locator: Environment, sentence beginning We must re-engage

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Environment. Undated page retrieved October 25, 2026; the meaning of re-engage is not assigned to a particular administration or treaty. No emissions target or energy deadline inferred. Latest position/current election applicability not established; human confirmation pending. Limited source review, not exhaustive.

proposals.summary: Crow supports efforts to “provide the Dreamers with a path towards citizenship” and broader immigration reform to give other undocumented immigrants and their families greater certainty.

evidence.excerpt: I believe we should provide the Dreamers with a path towards citizenship and reform the immigration system to bring the millions of other undocumented immigrants out of the shadows and provide certainty to them and their families.
evidence.locator: Immigration, sentence beginning I believe we should

platformIssues.researchScope: Campaign Values: Immigration, including surrounding discussion of family unity and border security. Undated, retrieved October 25, 2026. Citizenship path is explicitly stated for Dreamers; not generalized to every undocumented immigrant. No eligibility criteria or timetable inferred. Human confirmation of current applicability pending; limited source review, not exhaustive.

proposals.summary: Crow’s House office says he wants to “protect Second Amendment rights” and “pass common-sense gun safety laws”; the cited passage does not specify individual measures.

evidence.excerpt: As a gun owner, hunter, and former Army Ranger, Jason believes we can protect Second Amendment rights while also reducing gun violence. He is working to pass common-sense gun safety laws that help keep Colorado communities safe.
evidence.locator: Gun Violence Prevention / Protecting Colorado Communities, index description

platformIssues.researchScope: House Issues index: Gun Violence Prevention; campaign Values: Gun Violence Prevention for context. Specific gun-law mechanisms require further current-source review; limited source review, not exhaustive.

evidence.locator: Fighting Corruption / Putting People Over Special Interests, final sentence

platformIssues.researchScope: House Issues index: Fighting Corruption; campaign Values: Campaign Finance Reform and Defending Our Democracy for context.
